class.description:
Multi-agent interaction critic for decentralized collision avoidance.
Based on Trevisan et al. ICRA 2023: "Multi-Agent Path Integral Control for Interaction-Aware Motion Planning"
Subscribes to other robots' published trajectories and applies discontinuous collision penalties when ego trajectory overlaps with other agents' predicted trajectories. Uses trajectory endpoints as predicted goal positions and estimates velocities from trajectory deltas.
